name: How much does it cost to fix a dripping faucet?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to fix a dripping faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to fix a dripping faucet can vary based on the type of faucet, the extent of the damage, and the specific parts needed for replacement. Simple repairs, like replacing a washer or O-ring, are generally less expensive. More complex issues, such as replacing a cartridge or the entire faucet, will incur higher costs. Alpha-Plumbing Services provides upfront pricing after assessing the issue, ensuring you know the cost before any work begins.
